facts.quote: Priya Nair owns the Orion warehouse going forward
facts.claim: Priya Nair is the owner of the Orion warehouse (since the September 2026 ownership change).

facts.quote: the nightly load has to land by 06:30 UTC
facts.claim: The Orion nightly load must complete by 06:30 UTC.

facts.quote: we decided to raise StreamHub retention from 7 days to 14 days
facts.claim: The team decided to raise StreamHub retention from 7 days to 14 days.

facts.quote: The Standard plan is $1,150 per month and includes 5 million monthly active rows
facts.claim: Fivewire's published list price for the Standard plan is $1,150 per month including 5 million monthly active rows.

facts.quote: billed at $0.35 per 1,000 monthly active rows
facts.claim: Fivewire Standard overage is billed at $0.35 per 1,000 monthly active rows.

facts.quote: save 15% versus monthly billing
facts.claim: Fivewire's published annual billing discount is 15% versus monthly billing.

facts.quote: Annual plans renew automatically unless cancelled 60 days before the renewal date
facts.claim: Fivewire annual plans auto-renew unless cancelled 60 days before the renewal date.

facts.quote: Your current renewal date is 31 January 2027
facts.claim: Brightcart's current Fivewire renewal date is 31 January 2027.

facts.quote: We can hold you at $1,020 per month for the 12-month term if you sign the renewal by 30 November 2026
facts.claim: Fivewire offered to hold Brightcart at $1,020 per month for a 12-month term if the renewal is signed by 30 November 2026 (below the $1,150 list price).

facts.quote: Dana is the right person for commercial questions
facts.claim: Dana Whitcombe is Brightcart's Fivewire account manager for commercial questions; outages go through the Fivewire support portal.

facts.quote: retained for 24 months after the customer's last order
facts.claim: Policy 2.1: customer personal data in Orion is retained for 24 months after the customer's last order, then purged by the monthly purge job.

facts.quote: Raw clickstream events are retained for 13 months
facts.claim: Policy 2.2: raw clickstream events are retained for 13 months.

facts.quote: Temporary PII access is granted for no more than 90 days
facts.claim: Policy 3.2: temporary PII access is granted for no more than 90 days and can be renewed once.

facts.quote: must not be stored on shared drives or in personal cloud storage
facts.claim: Policy 3.3: production PII extracts must not be stored on shared drives or in personal cloud storage.

facts.quote: require written sign-off from the Head of Data
facts.claim: Policy 4.1: exceptions to the retention and access policy require written sign-off from the Head of Data.

facts.quote: the Airflow 2.10 upgrade is scheduled for 2026-10-20
facts.claim: The Airflow 2.10 upgrade was scheduled for 2026-10-20.

facts.quote: paying Monitorly $640 a month and the contract ends 2026-12-31
facts.claim: Monitorly costs $640 per month and its contract ends 2026-12-31.

facts.quote: evaluate Tallybase as a possible replacement for Monitorly, no decision yet
facts.claim: Priya Nair proposed evaluating Tallybase as a possible replacement for Monitorly; as of 2 Oct 2026 no decision was made (decision due 2026-10-15).

facts.quote: escalate to the secondary on-call if the primary has not acknowledged within 15 minutes
facts.claim: Orion pages escalate to the secondary on-call if the primary has not acknowledged within 15 minutes.

facts.quote: completed at 08:40 UTC on 2026-10-05, which is 2 hours 10 minutes after the 06:30 UTC deadline
facts.claim: INC-2291: the Orion nightly load completed at 08:40 UTC on 2026-10-05, 2 hours 10 minutes after the 06:30 UTC deadline.

facts.quote: The Checkout team added a new column to the orders table on 2026-10-02
facts.claim: INC-2291 root cause: the Checkout team added an unannounced column to the orders table on 2026-10-02, which blocked the Fivewire sync (block on change).

facts.quote: A schema contract check was added to the orders ingestion on 2026-10-06
facts.claim: A schema contract check was added to the orders ingestion on 2026-10-06; it pages the primary on schema mismatch.

facts.quote: Source teams must post schema changes in #src-schema-alerts at least 3 business days before release
facts.claim: Source teams must post schema changes in #src-schema-alerts at least 3 business days before release (Checkout owner: Tomasz Brandt).

facts.quote: The v1 events API is removed in 4.2
facts.claim: Orion 4.2 (released 12 October 2026) removes the v1 events API; /v1/events returns HTTP 410 and clients must use /v2/events.

facts.quote: The SDK now requires Python 3.12 or newer
facts.claim: The Orion 4.2 SDK requires Python 3.12 or newer.

facts.quote: default query timeout was raised from 300 seconds to 600 seconds
facts.claim: Orion 4.2 raised the default query timeout from 300 seconds to 600 seconds.

facts.quote: capped at $2.4 million for FY27
facts.claim: Data platform cloud spend is capped at $2.4 million for FY27, flat versus FY26.

facts.quote: A one-year reserved commitment of $410,000
facts.claim: Cobalt Cloud quoted a one-year reserved commitment of $410,000 for Orion compute (roughly a fifth below on-demand).

facts.quote: The hiring freeze for the two open data engineer roles holds until April 2027
facts.claim: The hiring freeze on the two open data engineer roles holds until April 2027.

facts.quote: I'm the budget owner and any request that pushes us over goes through me
facts.claim: Helen Okafor is the budget owner; any request exceeding the FY27 cap goes through her.

facts.quote: the Fivewire DPA refresh is still waiting for legal review and has not been signed
facts.claim: As of 2026-10-20 the Fivewire DPA refresh is waiting for legal review and has not been signed; nothing is approved.

facts.quote: Our policy requires a SOC 2 Type II report from every vendor processing PII
facts.claim: Security policy requires a SOC 2 Type II report from every vendor processing PII.

facts.quote: Fivewire does not retain Brightcart payloads after delivery to Orion
facts.claim: Per its questionnaire answer, Fivewire does not retain Brightcart payloads after delivery to Orion (Security wants this in the DPA text).

facts.quote: decided to run a 30-day Tallybase pilot starting 2 November 2026 while Monitorly stays the primary alerting system
facts.claim: The team decided to run a 30-day Tallybase pilot starting 2 November 2026; Monitorly stays the primary alerting system. Marcus owns the pilot.

facts.quote: retention change from the September sync was applied on 22 October, so retention is now 14 days
facts.claim: StreamHub retention is 14 days; the change was applied on 22 October 2026.

facts.quote: Marcus owns StreamHub, and Aiko is backup
facts.claim: Marcus Lindqvist owns StreamHub; Aiko Tanaka is backup.

facts.quote: get a first response within 2 business days
facts.claim: Requests to the Orion team go through #data-requests and get a first response within 2 business days; Priya Nair triages.

facts.quote: customer_360 refreshes every 4 hours
facts.claim: The customer_360 table refreshes every 4 hours (hourly refresh was dropped after the Orion 4.2 migration).

facts.quote: Checkout owns the orders-service and its schema
facts.claim: The Checkout team (Tomasz Brandt) owns the orders-service and its schema and is responsible for contract changes.

facts.quote: deletion requests are propagated to Orion within 7 days of the request
facts.claim: Customer deletion requests are propagated to Orion within 7 days of the request (target agreed with Legal and Priya Nair).
